test_cases.test_case: Submit with Username left blank (representative text required-field)
preconditions: User is on the Login page and unauthenticated
steps: 1. Leave the Username field blank
2. Enter <valid password> in the Password field
3. Click the Log in button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Username field indicating it is required; form does not submit and there is no redirect to Dashboard; Password field is cleared; Username remains blank and highlighted as required.

test_cases.test_case: Submit with Password left blank (password required-field representative)
preconditions: User is on the Login page and unauthenticated
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> in the Username field
2. Leave the Password field blank
3. Click the Log in button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Password field indicating it is required; form does not submit and there is no redirect to Dashboard; Password field remains empty; Username field retains the entered value.

test_cases.test_case: Submit with all required fields empty
preconditions: User is on the Login page and unauthenticated
steps: 1. Leave the Username field blank
2. Leave the Password field blank
3. Click the Log in button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation errors appear on both Username and Password fields indicating they are required; form does not submit and there is no redirect to Dashboard; Password field remains cleared/empty; Username remains blank.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt login with invalid credentials (authentication failure)
preconditions: User is on the Login page and unauthenticated
steps: 1. Enter <username> in the Username field
2. Enter <invalid password> in the Password field
3. Click the Log in button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline authentication error is displayed (login fails); Password field is cleared; Username field retains the entered value for correction; form does not redirect to Dashboard and no session is granted.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt 'Access as a guest' while authenticated (precondition not met)
preconditions: User is authenticated and on the Login page
steps: 1. Attempt to locate the 'Access as a guest' button on the page
2. If the button is visible, click the 'Access as a guest' button
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Access as a guest' control is not available for authenticated users (button is not visible or is disabled); clicking it does not grant a guest session or navigate; the user remains authenticated and on the current page.

test_cases.test_case: Click disabled 'Lost password?' link when feature is turned off
preconditions: User is on the Login page and unauthenticated
steps: 1. Attempt to click the 'Lost password?' link
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Lost password?' link is disabled/unavailable on this site (control is disabled and not clickable); clicking it does not navigate or open a recovery flow; there is no change of page or state.

test_cases.test_case: Username with leading and trailing whitespace is handled
preconditions: Login page is displayed
An existing account exists with username <username> and password <password>
steps: 1. Click the Username field
2. Type the Username value with one or more leading and trailing space characters (i.e. ' <username> ')
3. Click the Password field
4. Type <password> into the Password field
5. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: If the system trims leading/trailing whitespace from Username: the page redirects to the Dashboard (succeeds). If the system does not trim: the form submission is blocked with the inline error message shown; the Password field is cleared; the Username field retains the entered value including leading/trailing whitespace (is blocked / error shown).

test_cases.test_case: Credentials that include emoji and special characters are accepted when account exists
preconditions: Login page is displayed
An existing account exists whose Username and Password include special characters and emoji (e.g. Username contains emoji/special characters, Password contains emoji/special characters)
steps: 1. Click the Username field
2. Enter the account's Username (contains emoji/special characters)
3. Click the Password field
4. Enter the account's Password (contains emoji/special characters)
5. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully and redirects to the Dashboard (succeeds).

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click of 'Log in' does not cause duplicate navigation or duplicate session creation
preconditions: Login page is displayed
A valid account exists with Username <username> and Password <password>
steps: 1. Click the Username field
2. Enter <username> into the Username field
3. Click the Password field
4. Enter <password> into the Password field
5. Click the 'Log in' button twice rapidly (two clicks within one second)
test_cases.expected_result: Only a single successful submission is processed: the browser performs a single redirect to the Dashboard (succeeds); no duplicate Dashboard pages or duplicate sessions are created; no duplicate error messages are shown.

steps: 1. Enter <non-numeric input> into the Maximum points field

test_cases.test_case: Enrol users: leave User Search blank and submit

4. Click the 'Confirm' button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the User Search field indicating it is required; the Enrol Users dialog remains open; no user is added to the course.

test_cases.test_case: Enrol users: leave Role blank and submit
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Participants page
Enrol users dialog is opened
steps: 1. Click the 'Enrol users' button to open the Enrol Users dialog
2. In the User Search field, select <a user from search results>
3. Leave the Role dropdown blank / unselected
4. Click the 'Confirm' button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Role field indicating it is required; the Enrol Users dialog remains open; the selected user is not enrolled in the course.

test_cases.test_case: Enrol users: submit with all required dialog fields empty
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Participants page
Enrol users dialog is opened
steps: 1. Click the 'Enrol users' button to open the Enrol Users dialog
2. Leave the User Search field blank
3. Leave the Role dropdown blank / unselected
4. Click the 'Confirm' button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation errors appear on both User Search and Role fields indicating they are required; the Enrol Users dialog remains open; no user is enrolled and no changes are applied.

test_cases.test_case: Bulk actions: attempt to open 'With selected users…' when no users are selected (precondition not met)
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Participants page
No participant checkboxes are selected
steps: 1. Ensure zero participant checkboxes are selected in the Participants table
2. Click the 'With selected users…' dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: The 'With selected users…' control is disabled or otherwise not actionable when no participants are selected; clicking does not open the bulk actions menu and a visible helper/tooltip indicates that at least one participant must be selected to use bulk actions.

test_cases.test_case: Bulk actions timing: verify bulk actions are blocked immediately when selection precondition is false
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Participants page
No participant checkboxes are selected
steps: 1. Ensure zero participant checkboxes are selected in the Participants table
2. Focus the 'With selected users…' control (keyboard or mouse) and attempt to activate it (press Enter or click)
3. Attempt to select a bulk action option (if the menu appears)
test_cases.expected_result: Bulk actions are not accessible while no users are selected: the menu does not present actionable options (options are absent or greyed out) and a visible helper/inline message indicates selection of at least one user is required; no bulk action can be executed.

test_cases.test_case: Very long string entered into Enrol Users search is retained and executed
preconditions: Participants page is open
"Enrol users" button is visible
steps: 1. Click the "Enrol users" button
2. Enter a very long string (200+ characters) into the User_Search field
3. Observe the User_Search input field and the dialog search results area
test_cases.expected_result: The User_Search input retains the full entered string with no visible truncation and the dialog search executes; if there are no matches the dialog shows zero result rows and a visible empty-state message (search executes and input retention succeeds).

test_cases.test_case: Leading/trailing whitespace in User_Search is trimmed and still matches existing user
preconditions: Participants page is open
There is an existing user whose searchable identifier will match the trimmed input
"Enrol users" dialog is open
steps: 1. Enter a username with leading and trailing whitespace into the User_Search field
2. Press Enter (or trigger the search action)
test_cases.expected_result: Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed by the search; the trimmed value is used for matching and the existing user appears in the results list (search succeeds).

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click Confirm in Enrol Users dialog prevents duplicate enrollment
preconditions: Participants page is open
"Enrol users" dialog is open
User appears in the dialog search results
A Role is available to select
steps: 1. Select the target user from the dialog search results
2. Select a Role from the Role dropdown
3. Click the Confirm button twice in rapid succession
test_cases.expected_result: The Confirm action succeeds once and the second submission attempt is blocked; only one new participant entry for that user appears in the Participants table (second click is blocked / error shown if a duplicate would occur).

test_cases.test_case: Opening bulk actions after deselecting all is blocked when no users selected
preconditions: Participants page is open
At least one selectable participant row is present
steps: 1. Select a participant's checkbox in the Participants table
2. Deselect that same participant's checkbox so zero participants are selected
3. Click the "With selected users…" dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Opening the bulk actions is blocked; the dropdown does not open and displays a visible disabled state or tooltip indicating that at least one user must be selected (attempt to open bulk actions is blocked).

test_cases.test_case: Apply First_Name_Initial_Filter = 'All' returns the unfiltered full list
preconditions: Participants page is open
Participants table contains multiple users with various first-name initials
steps: 1. Select 'All' in the First_Name_Initial_Filter dropdown
2. Click the Apply filters button
test_cases.expected_result: Apply filters succeeds; the Participants table displays the full, unfiltered list of users (the filter action succeeds and the participants table shows all rows).

test_cases.test_case: Add multiple filter conditions then Clear filters removes all condition rows and Apply filters succeeds
preconditions: Participants page is open
Filter system is visible
steps: 1. Click the '+ Add condition' button
2. Click the '+ Add condition' button (second time)
3. Click the '+ Add condition' button (third time)
4. Click the 'Clear filters' button
5. Click the 'Apply filters' button
test_cases.expected_result: All condition rows are removed by Clear filters and Apply filters succeeds with zero conditions; the Participants table shows the unfiltered list and no validation error is shown (applying with zero conditions succeeds).

A student row with a visible Grade button exists for the assignment
steps: 1. Click the Grade button for the student
2. Immediately click the same Grade button again within a short interval (e.g., before the modal finishes animating)
test_cases.expected_result: Only one Grading_Interface modal is visible; the second click is ignored (no duplicate modals or duplicate grading contexts are created) — succeeds

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to navigate tabs while Grading_Interface modal is open

A student row with a visible Grade button exists for the assignment
steps: 1. Click the Grade button for the student to open the Grading_Interface modal
2. Click the Submissions tab in the tab bar while the Grading_Interface modal is visible
test_cases.expected_result: Tab navigation is blocked while the Grading_Interface modal is open; Submissions tab content is not displayed and the Grading_Interface modal remains visible (is blocked)

test_cases.test_case: Assignment description with very long text and special characters/emoji is displayed
preconditions: An assignment exists whose description contains a very long string (200+ characters) including special characters and emoji
Teacher is signed in and on the Assignment — Teacher View page
steps: 1. Open the Assignment tab
test_cases.expected_result: Assignment tab displays the full description text including special characters and emoji; the text is not truncated in the visible description area and attached files (if any) are listed — succeeds

test_cases.test_case: Assignment description containing leading and trailing whitespace is rendered
preconditions: An assignment exists whose description includes visible leading and trailing whitespace (spaces or blank lines) around the main text
Teacher is signed in and on the Assignment — Teacher View page
steps: 1. Open the Assignment tab
test_cases.expected_result: Displayed description does not show unintended leading/trailing blank space in the page layout; leading/trailing whitespace is normalized/trimmed for display so no extra blank lines appear at the start or end of the description — succeeds

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to edit Final Grade while Quick grading is disabled
preconditions: User is viewing the Submissions view
steps: 1. Navigate to the Submissions view
2. Ensure the Quick_Grading_Mode checkbox is unchecked (click it if it is checked)
3. Click the Final_Grade cell for any student row in the Submissions_Table
test_cases.expected_result: Final_Grade cell is not editable: no inline grade input or edit controls appear; clicking the cell does not open an editor; the displayed Final_Grade value remains unchanged (inline grading is disabled when Quick_Grading_Mode == false).

test_cases.test_case: Begin inline edit, then disable Quick grading and attempt to save
preconditions: User is viewing the Submissions view
steps: 1. Navigate to the Submissions view
2. Ensure the Quick_Grading_Mode checkbox is checked (click it if it is unchecked)
3. Click the Final_Grade cell for a student row to open the inline grade editor
4. Without saving, click the Quick_Grading_Mode checkbox to uncheck it (disable Quick grading)
5. While the inline editor is still visible, attempt to save the inline grade (press Enter or click the inline Save control)
test_cases.expected_result: Save is blocked and inline editing is cancelled: the inline grade editor closes or becomes read-only immediately after Quick_Grading_Mode is unchecked; the Final_Grade value remains unchanged; no grade update is submitted (Quick_Grading_Mode disabling prevents inline grade submission).

test_cases.test_case: Rapid repeat-click on Message button (duplicate composer prevention)

The second click does not create a second composer instance; either focus returns to the already-open composer or the second click is ignored. Only one messaging composer instance is visible; duplicate composers are not created (subsequent clicks are effectively blocked/ignored).

test_cases.expected_result: Single navigation occurs to the course profile page (navigation succeeds once). The second rapid click does not cause a duplicate navigation or an application error; only one course profile page is opened/loaded and no duplicate requests produce visible errors.
